brief: TradingView 全局控制中心 Atlas：账户读取、快捷操作、图表切换、沉浸模式、回放与复盘。用户要求参考青蛙图风格，10个不同的动物、物体或设计主体。
userStyleOverride: 以参考图的描边、高光、腮红、柔和立体感及完整主体构图为准；不同主体采用差异化轮廓，包含无脸物体。
constraints: Only one complete subject, no text, watermark, surrounding card, square tile, border frame, scene, props, or patterned backdrop. No photorealism, heavy 3D extrusion, hard metallic chrome, deep shadow, fine hair, sharp spikes, fragile lines, or micro-detail. Do not reproduce the frog character or its green palette. Do not crop the subject. Preserve both members of paired identifying features.

candidates.prompt:

Subject: A broad baby rabbit head with two short thick capsule ears visible, wide soft cheeks, no torso. Very compact oval face, one ear gently folded with a visibly blunt tip.
Palette: soft ivory #E7E7EB, lilac #A4A8E8, indigo accent #737BDD. If there is a character face, use deep charcoal eyes, small ivory eye glints and very restrained dusty pink blush as in the reference. Keep colors tasteful, softly muted and clear at a small scale.
Composition: one centered upright complete silhouette filling about 80–88 percent of the square, generous safety margin on every side, square canvas. All defining features fully visible. Show only the subject with clean open space around it, no ground plane or background scene.

Finish: soft, carefully controlled shading and delicate highlights like the supplied reference, friendly and refined. The complete result must be a single new subject, never multiple options, a grid or a contact sheet.
